title: Ravin the Elder
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He was Rav Papa’s student, as in [Bava Batra 146b](https://www.sefaria.org/Bava_Batra.146b.2), where he sat before him. In [Kiddushin 53b](https://www.sefaria.org/Kiddushin.53b.1): “Ravin the Elder interpreted before Rav”; Hyman proposes the reading “before Rav Papa,” as cited in Dikdukei Soferim on Pesachim 74b, note פ. And where we find in [Pesachim 74b](https://www.sefaria.org/Pesachim.74b.4), “Ravin the Elder coated a young pigeon for Rav,” he proposes the reading there as Rav Yeiva the Elder, whom he identifies as Rav’s student, as explained in his entry.[^2]

notes.text: The Dikdukei Soferim reference is letter פ, retained literally rather than presented as an independently established numbered note 80. Hyman’s proposed Papa/Yeiva readings and historical identification remain attributed. Saved Davidson Pesachim 74b retains Ravin the Elder in the coating episode.

[Seder HaDorot](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=182&lang=en) explicitly weighs the possibility of two men or of an older Rav Pappa. The linked Bava Batra places Ravin before Rav Pappa; Kiddushin and Pesachim name Rav. Hyman proposes a different authority in Kiddushin and a different name in Pesachim.
